# `content`

(0.3) Content a mod declares in `[content]` of `mod.toml` and the numeric ids the world gave it, plus cosmetics: a server mod puts one of its own cosmetics on a player and the modded clients draw it.

Package `blockheads:api@0.3.1` · Lua table `bh.content` · [WIT source](https://github.com/Blockheads-Club/mod-sdk/blob/dev/wit/blockheads-api/content.wit)

Uses: `types.{api-error}`, `players.{player}`

## Types

### `kind` <Badge type="info" text="enum" />

A kind of content.

| Case | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `block` | A block. |
| `item` | An item. |
| `cosmetic` | A cosmetic (hat, shirt, pants, shoes, hair, weapon skin). |

### `cosmetic-info` <Badge type="info" text="record" />

A cosmetic of a loaded mod.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | `string` | `<mod-id>:<name>`. |
| `mod-id` | `string` | The mod that declares it. |
| `slot` | `string` | `hat`, `shirt`, `pants`, `shoes`, `hair` or `weapon`. |
| `id` | `option<u32>` | The world's id; `none` on hosts that keep no registry. |

## Functions

### `id-of` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
id-of: func(kind: kind, key: string) -> option<u32>;
```

The id this world gave a declared key; `none` for an unknown key or on hosts without a registry.

### `key-of` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
key-of: func(kind: kind, id: u32) -> option<string>;
```

The key of an id; `none` when unknown.

### `cosmetics` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
cosmetics: func() -> list<cosmetic-info>;
```

The cosmetics of all loaded mods.

### `equipped` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
equipped: func(who: borrow<player>) -> result<list<tuple<string, string>>, api-error>;
```

What a player wears as (slot, key) pairs.

### `equip` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
equip: func(who: borrow<player>, key: string) -> result<_, api-error>;
```

Puts one of the calling mod's cosmetics on a player, replacing the one in its slot. Other mods' keys give `not-permitted`, unknown keys `invalid-argument`, a player who left `stale-handle`; clients get `unsupported`.

### `unequip` <Badge type="info" text="function" />

```txt
unequip: func(who: borrow<player>, slot: string) -> result<_, api-error>;
```

Takes the cosmetic of `slot` off a player.
